units.source_text: 每日的日记已了无印象。

en.t: The diary entries from those days had already left no impression on me.

units.source_text: 但是大夫头一次来，以及祖父临终的事，到底还是忆起来了。

en.t: But I did finally remember the first time the doctor came, and what happened when my grandfather was dying.

units.source_text: 平时，祖父是十分蔑视和不信任大夫的，

en.t: Ordinarily, my grandfather greatly despised doctors and did not trust them,

units.source_text: 一旦把大夫请来，他竟一百八十度大转弯，

en.t: but once the doctor was called in, he unexpectedly made a complete about-face,

units.source_text: 信赖起大夫来，乃至感激涕零。

en.t: began to trust the doctor, and even became so grateful that he was moved to tears.

units.source_text: 毋宁说，我感到祖父完全辜负了我。

en.t: Rather, I felt that my grandfather had utterly betrayed me.

units.source_text: 祖父很是可怜，我很同情他。

en.t: My grandfather was very pitiful, and I felt deeply sorry for him.

units.source_text: 祖父辞世当晚，正是昭宪皇太后奉安之夜，

en.t: The night my grandfather passed away was the very night of the enshrinement ceremony for Empress Dowager Shoken,

units.source_text: 去不去参加中学的遥拜式，我有点犹豫。

en.t: and I hesitated a little over whether or not to attend the distant-worship ceremony at the middle school.

units.source_text: 中学坐落在距我们村南边一里半地的小镇上。

en.t: The middle school was in a small town about one and a half ri south of our village.

units.source_text: 不知为什么，我神经质地竟想去参加遥拜式。

en.t: For some reason, I nervously found myself wanting to go to the distant-worship ceremony.

units.source_text: 可又担心我不在家，祖父会不会有三长两短？

en.t: Yet I was also worried that something might happen to my grandfather while I was away from home.
Miyo asked my grandfather for me.
